plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 4-date timeline completes: 1863 (Hermann von Helmholtz publishes On the Sensations of Tone proposing cochlear frequency resonance) · 1928–1947 (Georg von Békésy uses silver dust and strobe light to discover the cochlear travelling wave along the 35-mm basilar membrane) · Jul 1978 (David Kemp records otoacoustic emissions proving Thomas Gold's 1948 active cochlear amplifier, traced to dancing outer hair cells by William Brownell in Jan 1985 and prestin in May 2000) · 1979–1984 (Jim Hudspeth, David Corey & James Pickles reveal 10-microsecond tip-link mechanotransduction springs).
